description: How the marketplace roles relate to each other: shoppers buying from sellers, sellers funding ads and fulfillment, internal operators enforcing trust and delivering the promise, and the feedback loops that keep the flywheel honest.

relationTypes.name: Commercial
relationTypes.description: Buying, selling, and contracting of offers, ads, and services

relationTypes.name: Operational
relationTypes.description: Day-to-day fulfillment, delivery, enforcement, and resolution work

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Fees, refunds, and concessions settled through the marketplace

relationTypes.name: Information
relationTypes.description: Reviews, signals, and abuse intelligence flowing between roles

relations.name: Buys marketplace offers
relations.description: Discovers, compares, and purchases seller products through search, detail pages, and checkout, with the marketplace settling the order to the seller.

relations.name: Hands inventory to fulfillment
relations.description: Inbounds inventory into the fulfillment network so orders can be picked, packed, and shipped against the delivery promise shown at checkout.

relations.name: Pays fulfillment and storage fees
relations.description: Pays per-unit fulfillment, storage, and long-term inventory fees for network capacity used, reconciled against shipped orders in seller settlements.

relations.name: Delivers against the promise and resolves issues
relations.description: Delivers orders within the promised window, catches exceptions before the customer notices, and resolves post-purchase problems like late, lost, or damaged shipments.

relations.name: Issues refunds and concessions
relations.description: Refunds, replaces, or compensates when the delivery or product experience fails, at the lowest cost path that still keeps trust without rewarding abuse.

relations.name: Funds retail media campaigns
relations.description: Contracts brand and agency marketers to plan and run Sponsored Products, Sponsored Brands, and DSP campaigns from the seller's ad budget.

relations.name: Targets sponsored placements at shoppers
relations.description: Places sponsored offers into shopper search and browse journeys to capture demand and defend branded traffic at the moment of purchase intent.

relations.name: Vets sellers and enforces policy
relations.description: Verifies seller identity under obligations like the INFORM Consumers Act, monitors listings for counterfeit and policy violations, and suspends or reinstates offers and accounts.

relations.name: Reports suspect offers and abuse
relations.description: Flags counterfeit products, fake reviews, and scam-like listings, feeding the signals investigators use to open cases against bad actors.

relations.name: Rates products and sellers
relations.description: Leaves product reviews and seller feedback that drive discoverability, conversion, and account health for the seller's catalog.

relations.name: Shares abuse patterns with resolution ops
relations.description: Passes refund-abuse and fraud patterns to resolution operators so concession decisions stop rewarding serial abusers while staying generous to honest customers.
